candidates.name: Viral myopericarditis
support_spans: She was admitted with a working diagnosis of viral myopericarditis.
candidates.why: The patient presented with chest pain and dyspnea after recovering from an upper respiratory infection, which is consistent with viral myopericarditis.

candidates.name: Loeffler syndrome
support_spans: Laboratory studies revealed a leukocyte count of 12,000 cells/µL with an absolute eosinophil count of 1,570 cells/µL
candidates.why: The patient has a high absolute eosinophil count, which is consistent with Loeffler syndrome.

candidates.name: Mycoplasma pneumoniae infection
support_spans: Mycoplasma pneumoniae IgM and IgG were elevated
candidates.why: The patient has elevated Mycoplasma pneumoniae IgM and IgG, which suggests a possible infection.

candidates.name: Toxocara infection
support_spans: Toxocara serology was sent and was pending at discharge.
Further history elicited pica and exposure to two dogs and a cat.
candidates.why: The patient has a history of pica and exposure to animals, which increases the risk of Toxocara infection.

candidates.name: Viral myopericarditis
support_spans: Transthoracic echocardiography demonstrated a moderate circumferential pericardial effusion with right atrial collapse
candidates.why: The echocardiography results are consistent with viral myopericarditis.

candidates.name: Eosinophilic pneumonia
support_spans: Chest computed tomography revealed multiple pulmonary nodules with adjacent ground-glass opacities.
candidates.why: The CT scan results are consistent with eosinophilic pneumonia.
